query_before:
async function* queryKinMessagesWithStreaming({
  messages,
  system,
  toolSchemas,
  toolChoice,
  thinking,
  maxTokens,
  temperature,
  topP,
  topK,
  stopSequences,
  model,
  signal,
  wireMessages,
  outputConfig,
  contextManagement,
  onResponseHeaders
}) {
  const effortValue = outputConfig && typeof outputConfig.effort === "string" ? outputConfig.effort : undefined;
  yield* queryModelWithStreaming({
    messages,
    systemPrompt: asSystemPrompt(system),
    thinkingConfig: thinking,
    tools: [],
    signal,
    options: {
      model,
      toolChoice,
      extraToolSchemas: toolSchemas,
      maxOutputTokensOverride: maxTokens,
      temperatureOverride: temperature,
      topP,
      topK,
      stopSequences,
      effortValue,
      getToolPermissionContext: async () => getEmptyToolPermissionContext(),
      isNonInteractiveSession: true,
      hasAppendSystemPrompt: false,
      querySource: "agent:kin",
      agentId: "kin-slot",
      agents: [],
      mcpTools: [],
      wireMessages,
      outputConfigOverride: outputConfig,
      contextManagementOverride: contextManagement,
      honorCallerThinking: true,
      thinkingDisplay: thinking.type === "adaptive" ? thinking.display : undefined,
      onResponseHeaders
    }
  });
}
